instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a wide angle shows an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands upright on the left, facing right with a neutral expression. The man in the dark grey t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) leans forward from the right, extending his arms to place both hands on her chest while keeping his right leg stretched back. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the room, creating a warm red tone on the carpet.
elements: R1 leans forward and places both hands on R2's chest
R2 receives the two-handed chest contact while standing upright
R1 extends his arms toward R2 during the contact
R2 remains upright as the contacted person
